Usage
====

.. _installation:
Installation
------------

To use Weather Predictions, first install libraries using pip:

.. code-block:: console
    
    (.venv) $ pip install requirements.txt

.. _functions:
Functions
---------
You can use ``api.weather_api.fetch_weather_data()`` to get the weather data from the API. The function returns a JSON with the weather data:
.. autofunction:: api.weather_api.fetch_weather_data
